descriptions.notStarted: Kopee says she'll make a nice chair for the person who has released the seal of the #bMiwok Artifact#k. Let's go talk to her.
descriptions.inProgress: Kopee says that she'll make you a #bMiwok Chief's Chair#k as a token of her appreciation for your help. She says if I go and talk to Toh Relicseeker and release the seal of the #bMiwok Artifact#k 20 times using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k, she'll make me the chair. It's a great opportunity for me to receive a reward and the Chief's Chair from the Miwok Artifact.
descriptions.completed: Kopee gave me a Miwok Chief's Chair as a gift, thanking me for finding the Miwok Artifact. It's an impressive chair that is both soft and cozy.
